rv.q: In a sharp ensemble, Helena Wilson’s rival private detective Athena Faversham and Deborah Tracey’s Queen Victoria excel. This is a big moment for Rice: this week, I saw the Broadway revival of Chess , his 1986 collaboration with Abba songwriters, which was musically glorious but confused in storyline.
After a stint of solving cases in Germany, Holmes returns to find that a killer is taking out performers in London, with each of them being connected to “The Twelve Days of Christmas” song.

But would this festive fusion crack the case for the perfect night out? The game's afoot, so let's examine the clues... Sherlock Holmes and the 12 Days Of Christmas is a brand new adventure for the iconic detective.

If pantomime isn’t your thing, and you can’t sit through another viewing of A Christmas Carol or White Christmas , this cozy crime caper is a solid alternative. Directed by Phillip Breen and written by Ker and Reed, the show lovingly spoofs the pomposity of the great detecting duo, and fans of the genre will find a lot to enjoy.
